CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2632 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc. Bus nonce: cd543cebd2d8ecc87b43aaf1f0b5e309. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc` or `Fix review: blocked ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: cd543cebd2d8ecc87b43aaf1f0b5e309`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2632 ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2632-cd543ceb`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, round 2, PR #2632 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-LOOP-CPU. Head ab6216cee6b688b45d6f4b89b70f84563307cacc: 86b3fe71 plus the closures-autofix bot commit, which touches tests/closures.json only. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Round 1 (git fetch origin probe/rev-2632-a4ff6382; verdict.md) found the code sound. It blocked only on the body: closures UNDER-SCOPED was red and the body did not answer it. The body has now been patched (sha1 252b9779). Review this delta:
1. Under ## Red checks, closures is named UNDER-SCOPED and repaired by ab6216c, per ci-autofix.md; mutation is red at the three answered sites; the "has not run in CI" sentence is gone.
2. The body also names fast (3.14) and coverage-ratchet red in run 39874068348, with the sibling run 39874062299 on the same head green. It attributes them to the gate-lease priority concurrency flake in tests/entities.py, routed to R10-FLY-SUITE-ENV-FLAKES. Verify that from the job logs, and read check-runs at the head now (a rerun may have concluded).
3. ab6216c's carry-eligibility under orchestrator.md section 11.
4. pr-contract at the head passes the body.
Round 1's evidence (mutants, finder's harness, failing-test-first) carries over; do not repeat it unless the code moved.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
